items.evidence: A serial cargo test run reached EMFILE after roughly 600 library tests and cascaded into 438 unrelated filesystem and SQLite failures.
items.nextAction: Keep the writer connection budget regression tests in the merge gate.
items.resolutionEvidence: The global workspace-index writer pool now retains at most eight least-recently-used connections; the complete serial Rust library suite passed with 1049 tests green and 12 ignored.

items.evidence: tests/frontend/app-shell.test.tsx is 6733 lines and requires dedicated batching, serial execution, timeout handling, and individual retries.
items.nextAction: Move product journeys behind stable domain interfaces and retain only a bounded AppShell smoke layer.

items.evidence: On macOS, each large Rust test binary spends roughly two to three minutes in process startup before libtest begins, causing the former all-target Rust gate to exceed its 900-second budget.
items.nextAction: Profile test-binary startup outside libtest and reduce binary size or platform security scanning overhead without weakening the library and consolidated integration coverage.

items.evidence: The Stage 0 inventory reports 153 test files without an explicit capability mapping out of 535 discovered test files.
items.nextAction: Map high-risk unmapped tests first and split shared infrastructure contracts from product capability coverage.
